blocks.intro: Most disposal problems fall into one of these:

tiles.body: Something is jammed between the plate and the housing. Turn it off at the switch and don't put your hand in it.

tiles.h3: It Won't Turn On at All
tiles.body: The reset button may have tripped, or the motor or wiring has failed.
Leaks at the sink flange, the dishwasher connection or the body of the unit. A leak from the body usually means replacement.
Food buildup in the unit or the drain line. If the sink backs up, see [drain cleaning](/highland-park/drain-cleaning).

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposals in Older Highland Park Homes
blocks.intro: Nearly half of Highland Park homes were built before 1960, long before disposals were standard. That affects both repairs and new installs.

items.body: Older cast iron and galvanized kitchen drains are rougher inside, so ground food catches more easily. Run plenty of cold water with the disposal and keep grease out of it.
If your kitchen never had one, we'll check the drain setup and electrical access before we quote, so the install goes in right the first time.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Highland Park Homeowners

items.q: Should I repair or replace my garbage disposal?
items.preview: Jams and loose connections are repairs. A leaking body or dead motor means replacement.
items.answer: A jam, a tripped reset or a loose connection is a repair. A leak from the body of the unit or a burned-out motor usually means replacement, especially on an older unit.

items.q: What shouldn't go down a garbage disposal?
items.preview: Grease, bones, fibrous scraps, coffee grounds and eggshells.
items.answer: Grease, oil, bones, fibrous scraps like celery and corn husks, coffee grounds and eggshells. They dull the blades, jam the unit or clog the drain line.

items.q: How long does a garbage disposal last?
items.preview: Often around 8 to 15 years, depending on the model and use.
items.answer: Many last around 8 to 15 years, depending on the model and how it's used. Grinding hard or fibrous food shortens that.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal replacement cost?
items.preview: It depends on the unit and any changes needed. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit, whether the plumbing or electrical needs changes and whether it's a replacement or a new install. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
